Aircraft.name: Spearhead test
Aircraft.Instructions:
F-112 "Spearhead" by WhoTookCarter
Standard pitch, roll, yaw, throttle, brakes, and trim. VR-ready.
Control groups: 1 - Canopy 2 - Fuel Probe 3 - Afterburner 4 - Bomb Bay (must be open to drop bombs) 5 - Disarm (for formation flying and safe jettison) 6 - Jettison 7 - Eject 8 - Exterior Lights
